liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Let It Grow** (1 review): Reviewer especially likes the performance of Let It Grow, Other One, and Estimated Prophet [10]

## The recordings

- **gd81-09-30.sbd.jim.12229.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 23 songs; 177 min; rated 3.56/5 by 9 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer describes the soundboard recording as decent and the show as pretty good sounding; Reviewer calls it a killer sounding board of a solid, very well played show; Reviewer finds the first set a little rusty, expected for a tour opener [7][8][10]
- **gd1981-09-30.160234.aud.lamarre.vernon.sirmick.flac24**: audience recording; 12 songs; 82 min [5]
- **gd1981-09-30.123231.sbd.moore-berger.flac2496**: soundboard; 23 songs; 178 min [2]
- **gd1981-09-30.151110.sbd.hance.sirmick.flac24**: soundboard; 23 songs; 180 min [3]

## Around the show

- The reviewer notes the encore is missing from this specific Scottish performance [7]
- Reviewer imagines the band playing among pubs and bagpipers in Scotland [8]
- Reviewer expresses disappointment that the subsequent Eyes of the World jam is missing [10]
- At the interval, American sailors and a Scottish fan exchanged remarks in the crowded bar [12]
- The long drum solo prompted sober audience members to return to the bar [12]
- Garcia joked about warming up for hours, taking a break, then playing more [13]
- Reviewer describes the setlist as the quintessential 1981 lineup, solid from start to finish [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd81-09-30.sbd.jim.12229.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Source is SBD converted to WAV, noise-reduced in Cool Edit Pro, then EAC/SHN by jim [1]
- **gd1981-09-30.160234.aud.lamarre.vernon.sirmick.flac24**: taped by Unknown; transferred by Matt Vernon, SirMick; source: unknown audience recording (low gen) - from the collection of Doug Lamarre [5]. Also: MAMU and Big River patched from shnid 151110; cuts smoothed using SBD patches; Patches recoded to mono; EQ applied to correct the bright side of the recording [5]
- **gd1981-09-30.123231.sbd.moore-berger.flac2496**: taped by Jerry Moore; transferred by Rob Berger; source: sbd 2nd gen cassette, Jerry Moore's copy; [2]
- **gd1981-09-30.151110.sbd.hance.sirmick.flac24**: taped by John Hance; transferred by John Hance and SIRMick; source: Soundboard Cassette (1st gen) [3]
